'''Vincent Gu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[Pentecon XI Sealed Deck]] on 16 April 2000, according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d530">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-nyd530/ pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-ny], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 15 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-pentecon-xi-april-16th-in-ithaca-nyd530/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
